QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Special Mission - The Black Mage 2
QuestInfo.1:
Engage the Black Mage in battle for a certain period of time to weaken him.

#r* The special mission can be performed separately from the Alliance mission. You'll obtain 5,000 determination upon completion of the special mission, and it can be completed once a day.

#r* You can participate in the battle with the Black Mage in the giant's heart. Total time spent engaging the Black Mage is calculated when you exit the battle map. If your party engages in the battle, only the time you spent in battle will be counted.#k
QuestInfo.2: You stayed engaged in battle with the Black Mage long enough to complete the special mission.
